-- in --
package main

templ test(x bool) {
	<p>text @c() more</p>
	<p>
		text
		@c()
		more
	</p>
	<span>@icon() Save</span>
	<p>
		@c()
		.method
		@c()
		{ "s" }
		@c()
		(aside)
	</p>
}
-- out --
